title: Dashboard entry point, landing page and the six tiles
custom_preconds:
Signed in as owner/admin (storage state)
One invoiced Work Order exists for a test-created customer, dated in the current calendar month (seeded via API)
Browser storage holds no `dashboard.expandedTile` key
custom_steps:
1. Look at the top navigation for a 'Dashboard' entry, and confirm it sits immediately to the right of 'Reports'.
2. Select 'Dashboard' and confirm the dashboard screen opens.
3. Log out and log back in; confirm you land on the dashboard.
4. Confirm the figures shown are for the workplace currently selected in the top navigation.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A "Dashboard" entry appears in the top navigation.
  • Selecting "Dashboard" opens the dashboard screen.
  • A user with the Reports permission lands on the dashboard when they log in.
  • The dashboard shows figures for the workplace currently selected in the top navigation.
  • The "Dashboard" entry sits immediately to the right of the "Reports" entry.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490, story SV-9573 (S1 — Access & Entry Point); Dashboard v1 specification, Confluence page 788430850, section S1; read on 2 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R1: “The user sees a "Dashboard" entry in the top navigation.”
  • S1-R2: “When the user selects "Dashboard", the dashboard screen opens.”
  • S1-R3: “When a user who has the Reports permission logs in, the dashboard is the screen they land on.”
  • S1-R4: “The dashboard shows figures for the workplace the user currently has selected in the top navigation.”
  • S1-R5: “The "Dashboard" entry sits immediately to the right of the "Reports" entry.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
